# ijtiff

This is a general purpose TIFF I/O utility for R. The [`tiff`
package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=tiff) already exists for
this purpose but `ijtiff` adds some functionality and overcomes some
bugs therein.

- `ijtiff` can write TIFF files whose pixel values are real
  (floating-point) numbers; `tiff` cannot.
- `ijtiff` can read and write *text images*; `tiff` cannot.
- `tiff` struggles to interpret channel information and gives cryptic
  errors when reading TIFF files written by the *ImageJ* software;
  `ijtiff` works smoothly with these images.

The github repo of `ijtiff` is at <https://github.com/ropensci/ijtiff>.

## Installation

You can install the released version of `ijtiff` from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=ijtiff) with:

``` r

install.packages("ijtiff")
```

You can install the released version of `ijtiff` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ropensci/ijtiff) with:

``` r

devtools::install_github("ropensci/ijtiff")
```

## How to use `ijtiff`

The [Reading and Writing
Images](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/articles/reading-and-writing-images.html)
article is probably all you need to know.

## More about `ijtiff`

- [Text
  Images](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/articles/text-images.html)
  tells you more about what *text images* are and why you might ever use
  them.
- [The *ImageJ*
  Problem](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/articles/the-imagej-problem.html)
  explains the problem that `tiff` has when reading TIFF files written
  by *ImageJ* and how `ijtiff` fixes this problem.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as.raster(`*`<ijtiff_img>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/as.raster.ijtiff_img.md)
  : Convert an ijtiff_img object to a raster object for plotting

- [`as_EBImage()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/as_EBImage.md)
  :

  Convert an ijtiff_img to an
  [EBImage::Image](https://rdrr.io/pkg/EBImage/man/Image.html).

- [`count_frames()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/count_frames.md)
  [`frames_count()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/count_frames.md)
  : Count the number of frames in a TIFF file.

- [`display()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/display.md) :
  Basic image display.

- [`get_supported_tags()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/get_supported_tags.md)
  : Get supported TIFF tags

- [`ijtiff`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/ijtiff.md)
  [`ijtiff-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/ijtiff.md)
  :

  `ijtiff`: TIFF I/O for *ImageJ* users

- [`ijtiff_img()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/ijtiff_img.md)
  [`as_ijtiff_img()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/ijtiff_img.md)
  :

  `ijtiff_img` class.

- [`linescan_to_stack()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/linescan-conversion.md)
  [`stack_to_linescan()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/linescan-conversion.md)
  : Rejig linescan images.

- [`print(`*`<ijtiff_img>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/print.ijtiff_img.md)
  :

  Print method for an `ijtiff_img`.

- [`read_tags()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/read_tags.md)
  [`tags_read()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/read_tags.md)
  : Read TIFF tag information without actually reading the image array.

- [`read_tif()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/read_tif.md)
  [`tif_read()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/read_tif.md)
  : Read an image stored in the TIFF format

- [`write_txt_img()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/text-image-io.md)
  [`read_txt_img()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/text-image-io.md)
  [`txt_img_write()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/text-image-io.md)
  [`txt_img_read()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/text-image-io.md)
  : Read/write an image array to/from disk as text file(s).

- [`tif_tags_reference()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/tif_tags_reference.md)
  : TIFF tag reference.

- [`write_tif()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/write_tif.md)
  [`tif_write()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/ijtiff/reference/write_tif.md)
  : Write images in TIFF format
